title: llmcouncil v1 - opinion envelope
description: Stage 1 response envelope returned by a council seat. Normative contract; scripts/validate.py implements equivalent checks with the Python stdlib only (no jsonschema dependency required).

member.description: Seat name; must equal the 'seat' field of the request envelope.

answer_md.description: Full markdown answer in the language of the question. Must not mention the seat name (anonymized later for peer review).

assumptions.description: Optional; assumptions the answer relies on.

limitations.description: Optional; known gaps or caveats of the answer.
